camel_example: aliyun hbase DescribeInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-4f51d54g50000' --PageNumber 1 --ClusterId 'hb-bp1u0639js2h70000' --Tag.1.Value value --ClusterName test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DbType hbase
description_en: Queries the list of ApsaraDB for HBase instances in a specified region by calling DescribeInstances
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstances查询指定地域的HBase实例列表信息
kebab_example: aliyun hbase describe-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --db-type hbase --cluster-name test --cluster-id hb-bp1u0639js2h70000 --resource-group-id rg-4f51d54g50000 --tag Value=value Key=key --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region to which the instance belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html operation to query the region ID.

If you specify the Tag.N.Key and Tag.N.Value parameters, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html接口获取。

调用本接口时，如果传入了Tag.N.Key和Tag.N.Value参数，则本参数必须传入
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the instance list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 实例列表的页码，起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of rows to display per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多可显示的行数，最大值为100，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The service type. Valid values:
hbase: ApsaraDB for HBase Standard Edition or ApsaraDB for HBase single-node.
hbaseue: ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition.
bds: BDS data synchronization service
parameters.help_zh:
服务类型，取值：
hbase：HBase标准版或HBase单机版。
hbaseue：HBase增强版。
bds：表示BDS数据同步服务
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the ApsaraDB for HBase instance
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of target instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html operation to query target instance ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. You can query the resource group ID in the Resource Group console
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，可通过资源组控制台查询
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The key of the tag. The tag key and tag value form a key-value pair in the format of {"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}
fields.help_zh: 标签的键，与Tag Value组成标签的键值对，格式为{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag key. The tag value and tag key form a key-value pair
fields.help_zh: 标签键的值，与Tag Key组成标签的键值对
fields.name: value
